title: August and the Colony
author: Jude Thornbury
blurb: Juniper Winterbourne, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
